assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game asset for a hand-painted fantasy RPG. Warm amber lantern light, cool blue-grey shadows, readable silhouettes, aged leather, brushed metal, textured painterly finish, friendly adventure mood. No text, letters, numbers, UI, logos or watermark. Asset: overhead tactical battle map, rectangular 6 columns by 5 rows playable area, no drawn grid. Old flooded archive courtyard at night, wet flagstone paving, perspective strictly top-down orthographic. All playable floor fills the entire rectangular image edge to edge. Only obstacles: low stone rubble completely within cells (zero-based x,y) (2,1),(2,2),(3,3); small low crates within cells (4,1),(1,3). Otherwise empty traversable paving. Faint moss, puddles and amber lighting. No people. Landscape 6:5 aspect ratio.
